title: The interim look after development (dev-01 to dev-05, with hp-01 described): the heat-term and onset fits, their leave-one-day-out errors, the prefix length bias, the High Power table and step 3's drift statistic, on the GPU rail and on DC-in; then freeze 2. DRAFT: every placeholder names an open question for the research lead.

when.describe_blocks_rule: hp-01 is read if it is DESK_FINAL when the look runs. The fit and freeze 2 do not wait for it (PENDING:Q9). If fewer than 9 of hp-01's 12 legs are included, the lead tells the research lead before the look (RL-157 §4).
before: the W1 receipt is signed, for the drift tripwire (RL-151 §1.3 item 2)

reads.day_rule: A leg's calendar day is the local date of its span's t0 (RL-155a §1.2). A block's pilot and remainder on one date count as one day (RL-155 §2 notes). The day is the unit of every leave-one-out error (RL-149 §2.3).

never_read.what: qualification legs (qual-01 to qual-03): sealed until freeze 2, and they do not run before it
ctl-01: its own look, after the print code is frozen
F0 (Part C bridge), F2 and F3 filler runs and every Part C run: not read under any look unless the research lead rules so
W1, every C and T window and every v4 member: no W1, C or T energy enters any fit
a rejected attempt (runtime.rejected<N>): it stays in custody and is not opened (PENDING:Q13 covers reserve legs, not attempts)
step 3's nine rehearsal legs: already read once, not campaign legs (PENDING:Q19)

custody_files.carries: journal: TV0h, TV1h, Tf08, fan, os_level, pm_state, stamps

custody_files.basename: rich_telemetry.jsonl row times and raw/powermetrics.plist frame times
custody_files.carries: timestamps only, for rule 3's gap check

custody_files.basename: hazards/meter/stream-*.jsonl header, trailer and sample timestamps
custody_files.carries: timestamps and counts only, for rule 4 (PENDING:Q7)

custody_files.basename: events.jsonl token events and outputs/align_turns.jsonl lengths
custody_files.carries: token index and stamps; output token ids are counted, never kept

custody_files.scope: span, cut to each leg's interval

channels.source: power_trace.csv gpu_power of the accepted attempt (step 3's convention: sum of window-mean power x overlap)
channels.read_as: per turn: from the turn's first prefill stamp to its last stamped token, less the G0 interval (S_w's E_j, RL-149 §2.7); per 256-token block for the prefix bias and statistic (iii)

channels.source: KM003C sample lines of the span's meter stream, cut to the same intervals by stamp
channels.read_as: the same intervals as gpu_rail; every print repeated on this channel

heat_term.response: PENDING:Q2 (proposal: per turn, E on the channel less the count-only prediction from logged prefill and decode tokens at the frozen rates, fitted jointly with the heat term on development legs only)
heat_term.model_family: PENDING:Q1 (proposal: H = load_seconds_from_counts x (b0 + b1 start_tf08 + b2 start_fan_rpm + b3 start_tv0h_excess_over_soak_reference), ordinary least squares, one fixed effect per prompt-size cell; the sign of no term assumed)
heat_term.missing_start_reading: A turn with a missing or stale start reading (last journal reading at or before the turn start, fresh under the 2 s rule) takes the count-only prediction and the flag start_reading_missing; it does not enter the heat-term fit (RL-149 §2.7, §1.6 item 1).
heat_term.outside_calibrated_range: The calibrated range of each start predictor (min and max over included development legs) is frozen in freeze 2; a later reading outside it sets heat_extrapolated (RL-149 §2.7).

onset.definition: Seconds from the turn's first decode token to the first journal or powermetrics reading that is off-state (OS level above 0, or a power-management state other than Nominal on a fresh stamp), as RL-149 §1.3 defines the state cut without its 2 s guard. PENDING:Q4 for the clock (load seconds or wall seconds).
onset.censoring: PENDING:Q4 (proposal: a turn that never leaves the state is right-censored at its last token; Tobit-style fit)
onset.error: Leave-one-day-out error of the predicted onset in seconds, per held-out day; the count-only cut is the predicted onset less twice this error (RL-149 §4 item 1).

validation.hot_stretch: PENDING:Q3 (proposal: a turn's decode from its first off-state reading to its last token)
validation.relative_error: PENDING:Q3 (proposal: per held-out day, |sum of predicted - sum of measured| / sum of measured over that day's hot stretches; median and maximum printed; qualified compares the maximum to 2 %)

sensitivity: The fit's result with and without spans marked 'reference from an excluded leg' (RL-161 §4) and, PENDING:Q20, 'reference from a redo' (RL-158 Q2).
Prompt size enters as assigned by the cell law, not as a free draw (RL-158 Q7).
reads_never: any slot, instruction or v4 label

rules.text: It ran to its decode cap, or was cut by T_dead where the design says it should be.
Sidecar coverage of at least 99 % with no gap over 2 s, and powermetrics gaps within the U1 bound (PENDING:Q7 for the U1 number).
The KM003C was present and its stream is clean, since every leg is analysed on DC-in as well as the GPU rail (PENDING:Q7 for 'clean').
It is not an attempt judged contaminated under the load-redo rule (above 0.5 core of outside load for 60 s), whether or not a redo replaced it.
The power mode is the block's.

prints.what: Per leg, the six rules' verdicts and the marks; included counts per block, cell and G0 role. Reads no energy.
The heat-term coefficients and their covariance.
Leave-one-day-out relative error over the hot stretch.
Leave-one-day-out relative error over the leg.
Prefix length-only bias in score SD, each with its 90 % interval; prefix comparison as corrected (the long leg to L*, the short to L*/ratio of load). 1.374 is a grid point with no standing.
The onset model's coefficients and its censored count.
The onset model's leave-one-day-out error in seconds.

Onset, clock, share of decode scored and energy ratios against Automatic at matched cell, soak and span position, with the Automatic block-to-block spread from dev-01 and dev-02 beside each ratio, the included count per row and cold starts marked by the measured start reading. Description only.
prints.caption: Soak in Automatic; mode set N s before the first leg's G0. The research lead owns the caption (RL-157).

prints.what: Step 3's statistic (iii), the pre-cut drift, on the development legs, by the frozen step 3 code; with the drift's form when it is well above 2 %.
Whether the leave-one-day-out error over the hot stretch is at or under 2 %: the interim half of S_w's and K_w's qualified field.
The fit with and without marked spans.
Legs whose realized prompt count is more than 5 % from nominal.
The blind statement's entry: date, code hash, output hash, analyst seat.

forbidden_content: a per-leg or per-turn joule, watt or energy value
a sample line of any stream
a token id or any text
any condition, slot or instruction key or label
any value from a qualification, control, filler, Part C, W1, C, T or v4 run

decisions.rule: Above the threshold: the S row comes back to the research lead before the W1 receipt is signed. Otherwise nothing happens.
At or under the threshold passes the interim half of qualified; the qualification look supplies the other half.
decisions.action: print 'passes' or 'fails'; S_w stays print-only either way

decisions.statistic: hp-01 included legs from the inclusion table
decisions.rule: Fewer than 9 of 12 included: the lead tells the research lead before the look and the research lead rules on a second High Power block.
decisions.action: report; the look does not wait

decisions.rule: PENDING:Q12 (proposal: none is written here; any extension beyond the cap needs a ruling, written before qualification energy is opened)
decisions.action: print 'none written; any extension needs a ruling'

custody.custody_copy: One verified custody copy of the roster's spans by the existing offload tooling, made while the MBP is unarmed; the look runs on that copy, never on the MBP's measurement root.
custody.host: The Air, under AIR-QUIET.lock, with no live generator, reader or real run on that host.
no_import_by: every frozen path of every leg kit
custody.disclosure: The amendment's blind statement lists this look with its date, code hash and output, worded as RL-150 R6 restates RL-149 §2.6: none comes from a run with a sabotage instruction, a slot or a v4 member.
custody.pre_run_check: PENDING:Q15 (proposal: the code's unit tests on synthetic inputs, then a structure-only dry run over the resolved roster that opens only inclusion and journal files and prints counts, before the energy stage)

review.cold_seat: One cold seat that did not write the fit code, against RL-149 §2.6 and §2.7 as amended; Mythos 5.2 and a Sol seat
review.due: Manifest and cold-seat report to the research lead by Mon 16 Nov 2026 18:00 PST; the research lead's pass the same day

open_questions.question: No fit code exists on any ref. Which seat writes it, and what model family does freeze 1 fix? No ruling names the heat term's functional form.
open_questions.proposal: The analyst seat (Opus) writes joulewise/cadence_looks/fit_interim.py; heat term linear in count-derived load seconds with start-state interactions, one fixed effect per prompt-size cell; the cold seat attacks the form.

open_questions.question: What is the heat-term fit's response on campaign legs? In the series, S_w's heat term is an offset beside the five-term leave-one-out count prediction, which conditionless single-turn legs cannot supply.
open_questions.proposal: Per turn, channel energy less a count-only prediction (prefill and decode tokens at the frozen rates), fitted jointly with the heat term on development legs only.

open_questions.question: What are 'the hot stretch' and 'relative error' in the interim print and in qualified's 2 % bar?
open_questions.proposal: Hot stretch: decode from the first off-state reading to the last token. Relative error: per held-out day, |sum predicted - sum measured| / sum measured; the maximum over days is compared to 2 %.

open_questions.question: The onset model: does start TV0h excess join its predictors (RL-150 R1 amended only §2.7's list)? Is onset in load seconds or wall seconds? How are turns that never leave the state treated?
open_questions.proposal: Predictors start Tf08 and load seconds as RL-149 §4 item 1 wrote; load seconds; right-censored at the last token.

open_questions.question: Where do the 'frozen prefill and decode rates' come from: fitted at this look from token stamps (no energy) and frozen in freeze 2, or fixed earlier?
open_questions.proposal: Fitted at this look from token stamps on development legs and frozen in freeze 2.

open_questions.question: The frozen step 3 code (sha256 84a1a553...) is on no ref and hard-codes its nine rehearsal legs. How is it applied to development legs 'by the frozen step 3 code'?
open_questions.proposal: Commit it byte-identical under joulewise/cadence_looks/ and add a small frozen adapter that calls its per-leg functions on the roster's accepted attempts; the cold seat checks the adapter changes no definition.

open_questions.question: Rules 3 and 4 at the look: the U1 bound's number for powermetrics gaps, and what 'clean' means for the KM003C stream. May rule 4's code read sample timestamps (not values) at the look?
open_questions.proposal: U1's registered number cited by line; clean = trailer counts zero (bad_polls, usb_errors) and no sample gap over 2 s inside the leg's interval, from timestamps only.

open_questions.question: Should the inclusion verdicts be computed and committed (by hash) before the energy stage opens anything?
open_questions.proposal: Yes: a two-stage look; the manifest sets verdicts_frozen_before_energy true.

open_questions.question: If hp-01 is not desk-final when dev-05 is, does freeze 2 wait for it?
open_questions.proposal: No. The fit and freeze 2 run at dev-05's DESK_FINAL; the High Power table runs later by the same frozen code as a separately disclosed read.

open_questions.question: Freeze 1 fixes 'the looks' output schema' (plural) and RL-151 §6 asks for section 2.2's prints in the manifest. Does this manifest also fix the qualification look's prints?
open_questions.proposal: Yes, declared here (bias at 1.10 and 1.30 with 90 % intervals; the type-M residual prints not_run, since RL-165 §8.1 took type M out); a separate lm-qual-01 pins its code before freeze 2.

open_questions.question: The drift tripwire's threshold. Step 4's RL-151 §1.3 cells (evidence step4-rl151-drift.md at d37b9d9b3) kept the rows at or under .035 at every drift from 3 to 8 %, the top of the scan, so the boundary was not found.
open_questions.proposal: 8 %, the largest drift simulated, plus step 4's caveat as a print: if (iii) is well above 2 %, print the drift's form.

open_questions.question: RL-149 §2.3's extension rule (sized from the interim errors, written before qualification energy is opened): does it go in this manifest?
open_questions.proposal: No rule written; any extension beyond 132 legs needs a ruling.

open_questions.question: Do reserve-01 legs that replace excluded development legs enter this look's fit?
open_questions.proposal: Yes, as development legs of the same cell, marked serves_phase development in the span ledger.

open_questions.question: If dev-05 carries type-T legs, do they enter the heat-term fit?
open_questions.proposal: No, describe-only at this look; the fit stays on single-turn legs.

open_questions.question: Pre-run check: RL-149 §1.4 reviewed step 3 against a synthetic input; the 11-13 standing practice for analysis is a blind dry run on real custody. Which, or both?
open_questions.proposal: Both: synthetic unit tests for the code review, then a structure-only dry run over the real roster that opens no energy file.

open_questions.question: May the output carry per-leg energy values, or fits, errors and ratios only?
open_questions.proposal: Fits, errors and ratios only, as step 3; the coefficient file carries the fit's own parameters.

open_questions.question: Campaign energy includes 'the other rails', but the interim prints name only the GPU rail and DC-in. Are the CPU, ANE and package rails read?
open_questions.proposal: Not read at this look.

open_questions.question: R4 says the block ledger points at the manifest by hash; BLOCK-QUEUE's schema is closed and has no field for it.
open_questions.proposal: A small blocks.py change (not a frozen path of any kit) adds a top-level look_manifests list when the manifest is committed.

open_questions.question: Are step 3's nine rehearsal legs kept out of the fit?
open_questions.proposal: Yes: they are not campaign legs and were already read.

open_questions.question: RL-161 §4 asks for the fit with and without 'reference from an excluded leg' spans. Should 'reference from a redo' spans get the same print?
open_questions.proposal: Yes, both.
